summary: Compute Node lexical relative paths after resolving both endpoints with the same cwd and path flavor.

requirements.path_flavor: default host, posix, or win32 is statically known

semantics.resolution: both operands are resolved before comparison
semantics.empty_operand: treated via path.resolve, therefore may use cwd

caveats: Path.GetRelativePath has different platform normalization and same-path output semantics.
